summary: Frontend-only testing of the new 'Keep me signed in on this device' opt-in feature on Kodama Talk. Verified: default-ON keep-signed-in return flow, lock signs out fully and clears persisted stay, opt-out flow (session-only), claim-implies-stay, plus regressions (drop send on /alex, owner shelf load, theme toggle persistence). All scenarios passed. No frontend or integration issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: unlockOwner correctly removes owner-cred when remember=false (prevents resume-owner button leaking after explicit opt-out). Good.
activeSession() reads sessionStorage first, then falls back to localStorage stay key - clean fallback pattern.
endSession clears both session + stay keys but preserves owner-cred, matching spec (resume-owner may still appear after lock but requires password).

Minor: key-card-ack checkbox lives in sticky footer; when window is short, Playwright reports 'outside viewport' for regular click. Real users unaffected but worth noting for future test harnesses (workaround: click via evaluate).
test_credentials: Owner unlock for /alex: password 'secret' (any 4+ chars). Claim: any name + 4+ char password.
seed_data_creation: Claimed /keepme123 during testing (persisted in localStorage - can be cleared by removing kodama-talk/v1/state key).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All keep-signed-in scenarios verified end-to-end via Playwright against preview URL. Session key naming: sessionStorage 'kodama-talk/v1/session:<addr>', localStorage 'kodama-talk/v1/stay:<addr>' (persist), localStorage 'kodama-talk/v1/owner-cred:<addr>' (device remembered). Simulate return-after-tab-close by window.sessionStorage.clear() + reload.
